verdict.rationale: Relay's marketing says it can "capture receipts" alongside real-time expense categorization and accounting sync (relay-docs-3), so basic receipt capture is claimed. Nothing describes how receipts are submitted or whether they are matched to transactions automatically. The bill-upload item (relay-docs-4) is about vendor bills, not card receipts, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: email-forwarding of receipts, receipt upload flow documentation, automatic matching of receipts to the correct transaction, support docs or independent/hands-on corroboration.
